next.reason: 1985: 'Each literal must be a nonnumeric literal and must not be a figurative constant that begins with the word ALL.'; 2023: 'Literal-1, literal-2, literal-3, and literal-4 shall not be a figurative constant that begins with the word ALL.'. 1985 bars an ALL figurative for every literal; 2023 bars it only for literal-1 to literal-4, so literal-5 (CONVERTING TO operand) may now be ALL. Boolean and national literals are added.
